title: NYC Daily Digest
text:
☀️ Good morning, Matthew! It's Sunday, November 1, 2026. Clocks fell back an hour overnight, so you get an extra hour today.

🌤️ Weather
Partly sunny and mild, good weather for the marathon. It's cool this morning, around 50°F. High of about 62–65°F, low of about 48–50°F tonight. Rain chance is about 10%.
What to wear: a light jacket or sweater over layers, and sunglasses. You can leave the umbrella at home.

🗞️ Headlines
• Midterms are this Tuesday, Nov 3, and today is the last day of early voting in New York.
• US–Iran: Several outlets report that Washington told Gulf allies to expect a "short and intense" strike campaign after the election. Trump says "anything's possible."
• Iran's Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei ordered an "immediate" response with no geographic limits if US strikes resume. Qatar and other mediators are pressing Tehran to make nuclear concessions.
• Markets: Worries about AI spending hit chip stocks this week, and Apple reportedly passed Nvidia as the most valuable company.
• Bulgaria holds its presidential runoff today, after a close first round between Iotova and Gyurov.

🚇 Getting around
• Marathon day: The Verrazzano is closed from 7a to 4p, the Queensboro lower level from 6:30a to 5:30p, and the Willis and Madison Ave bridges from 7:30a to 6:30p. Expect big closures on 4th Ave in Brooklyn, 1st Ave, 5th Ave, and around Central Park, some lasting into the evening. Buses are detoured, including the M60-SBS and M72.
• Weekend subway work: Some trains are rerouted between Brooklyn and Manhattan, skipping stops like High St, Fulton, Chambers, Canal, and Spring. There are shuttle buses between Broadway Junction and Canarsie. J/M service may not run between Myrtle Av and Manhattan.
• Taking the subway beats driving today, but check the MTA app before you go.

🎉 NYC today
• TCS NYC Marathon: About 60,000 runners cross all five boroughs, and this year's route through the Bronx is new for the first time in 15 years. Good places to cheer are 4th Ave in Brooklyn, 1st Ave in Manhattan around the 60s–90s, and the finish in Central Park.
• Early voting: It's the last day to vote early before Tuesday. Check your early voting site, since it may not be your Election Day polling place.

💡 Nugget
The clock change is a good reminder to test your smoke and CO detector batteries. Sunset is around 4:50 PM from today, so get outside while it's light.
